chunk.content: The East Asian fourfinger threadfin (Eleutheronema rhadinum) was historically misidentified as the fourfinger threadfin (E. tetradactylum) because the two look very similar.
chunk.source_quote: was historically misidentified as E. tetradactylum due to their high degree of morphological similarity

source.title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of the East Asian fourfinger threadfin, Eleutheronema rhadinum (Jordan & Evermann, 1902) (Scientific Data; doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06303-y)
